alignment.method: Installed Windows offline English recognition with exact narration grammar and 16 kHz temporary input. Phrase-relative word audio ranges plus phrase start provide estimated times.
alignment.boundary: The maximum is quantization error relative to the estimate, not measured perceptual alignment error. No independent human listening review is claimed.

video.waveform: Per-frame mono 48 kHz PCM RMS energy from the original authorized recordings, normalized to the segment 95th percentile. Bars stop cycling when the video card is not the spoken focus; no synthetic sine-wave animation remains.
